name: simulate-funding-fixed-point-boundary
why: Measured reach for the annual tax/withdrawal/ACA funding-control extraction. The full corpus exercises ordinary direct and bounded roots, finite-portfolio exhaustion, coordinated HECM multi-probe sizing, ACA actionable and fail-closed inputs, annual-pass re-entry, and all four equivalence modes.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. The direct coordinator tests pin bisection/nonconvergence, gross ACA fallback, both conflicting-basin directions, HECM probe reset, input purity, and exact selected-object identity. The hostile delegation test separately injects non-economic accepted values and proves simulatePlan consumes the coordinator result instead of recomputing the root.
